scope: Read-only feasibility/design; no production edits, target build, SPI/GPIO or other hardware access. Proposed interfaces are not implemented.

decision.blocking_existing_admission: No ownsDedicatedBus proof currently exists. Bringup accepts already-initialized bus; that return value does not prove exclusive ownership.
decision.physical_validation: No GPIO readback or source review proves a glitch-free pad handoff. Board waveform observation remains required before a production timing/safety claim.

ownership_findings.fact: Active application creates one SPI3 ADS device. Other add-device implementation is excluded by configuration. No current ownsDedicatedBus field or generic SDK public device inventory guarantees that fact dynamically.

Runtime presence uses the existing handle/mutex even when adsReady is false. Cold persistent slot is used only with no ordinary mutex. Both main callers are serial full-frame boundaries; boot owner must be quiescent and cold-slot busy/pending/quarantine rejected.

Persistent DMA descriptor and buffers are not reused until get_trans_result returns the exact descriptor. Existing byte helper releases ADS mutex immediately after completion; new tail helper must keep it held until last clock and restored GPIO route.

Only portMAX_DELAY is accepted, so no bounded acquisition can be claimed. Under an explicit exclusive-bus capability plus all-client ownership gate no separate bus-acquire API is necessary; unknown/shared bus must reject this experiment.

datasheet_findings.fact: TIMEOUT disabled has no minimum SCLK frequency. Enabled requires minimum 1kHz; section9.4.4.5 describes 65536 fCLK cycles (~8.9ms) byte timeout. Candidate should admit only known TIMEOUT=0 and retain the diagnostic overall deadline.
SCLK rising edge to valid DOUT max60ns at specified20pF||100kohm load; high/low minimum40ns. A 1us high wait gives software margin, not measurement of actual board loading.
DOUT updates on rising SCLK, DIN latches falling; return SCLK low. Noise/glitches can advance the serial bit position.

RDATA1 is opcode plus optionalSTATUS+4data+CRC; present profile is8+48bits. Read command is not complete after55clocks. Last GPIO rising edge requests CRC bit0; sample while high before final falling edge. DOUT behavior during the final pad transition and actual GPIO waveform remain board-test questions.

transfer_layout.dma_storage_lifetime: handle-owned permanent storage; existing pool exceeds8B
transfer_layout.rx_layout: rx[0] opcode-phase discard; rx[1] STATUS; rx[2..5] data; rx[6] bits7..1 CRC prefix; bit0 unreceived/undefined
transfer_layout.assembly_prohibition: Never derive the bit from computed CRC, last successful value, parity statistics or a retry. Preserve prefix and independently validate original CRC polynomial.
transfer_layout.idf_support: S3 SPI_LL_TX_MINI_EXTRA_BITS=2 and RX_MINI_EXTRA_BITS=1, so remainder7 is legal. spi_master allocates ceil(bitlength/8); DMA writes4-byte units. spi_common.h SPI_SWAP_DATA_RX documents peripheral writing from MSB.

minimum_diagnostic_implementation_propos: Retain separate board-created-exclusive-bus capability only after successful fresh spi_bus_initialize and single successful add-device; reject already-initialized or helper/shared/changed configuration. Capability includes exact device/host/pins/mode/CS, not a user toggle.

Restrict to existing safe timing command boundary: known CAP/VOLT route, INTREF off, AA input, same MODE/REF/PGA/freshness rules, boot task quiescent, no presence slot busy/pending/quarantine, no active DMA. No global GPIO-tail mode or runtime replacement.

Use a new explicit diagnostic read entry sharing existing FreshChecked logic; a private transfer operation keeps existing ADS mutex through queue(55), exact descriptor completion, tail clock and SPI-route restore. Do not alter normal FreshChecked or add a global setting that survives the helper.

Before queue, inspect public gpio_get_io_config: SCLK output route equals SPI3_CLK_OUT_IDX, no inversion/open drain/hold, input enabled; MISO input enabled; saved configuration preserved. Preload GPIO SCLK output latch0 while SPI still owns pin. Never gpio_reset_pin or disable output during handoff.

After exact completion, require actual SCLK low. Switch only SCLK output selector to SIG_GPIO_OUT_IDX with supported ESP ROM API. With both source levels low, drive high, wait>=60ns (suggest1us), physically read GPIO14, then drive low; restore SPI3_CLK_OUT_IDX. Do not detach or drive MISO/MOSI. Validate restored logical route and low level.

Keep final-edge helper short, no printf/network/heap/delay ticks inside lock. If using a short local critical section, use IRAM/ROM-safe GPIO/HAL operations and a private non-contended lock, not existing flash-resident gpio functions under a fictitious bounded guarantee. Account for any DRDY interrupt delay separately.

Parse exactly originalSTATUS+4data+assembledCRC through unchanged parser; bad CRC remains invalid. Preserve raw55 prefix and actual sampled tail bit, timestamps, selected clock, DRDY/config generations and restored route status. All records diagnostic science0.

Complete known in-progress tail during reserved cleanup if a work deadline expires after55clocks; do not issue register commands while RDATA is partial. If phase/route or DMA completion is unknown, quarantine, preserve storage, and do not attempt ordinary SPI restore/deinit/remove or extra guessed clocks. Main remains queryable and controlled restart is explicit.

Keep total2s and500ms cleanup allowance; do not claim full200x4 completion when exhausted. Pre/post full snapshot verification remains mandatory after serial framing is known complete. Original error and cleanup error remain separate.
important_limits: The task/ISR handoff adds an inter-clock low pause; the experiment changes both tail sampling and timing phase. CRC improvement alone does not prove exact silicon/pad mechanism.
gpio_get_io_config and GPIO low readback verify software routing/level only, not absence of a nanosecond glitch or analog isolation.
The final1us wait is chosen above specified DOUT delay; current board load and electrical margins require measurement.
No precision, FPS or arbitrary-lifetime reliability claim follows from a bounded successful diagnostic; actual CPU and transaction duration must be measured.
CRC covers only the4data bytes. STATUS and valid freshness must continue separate checks.
minimum_regressions: All256 CRC byte patterns split into upper7 physical SPI bits plus sampled GPIO bit, including both tail values; changing sampled bit must change assembled byte even when computed CRC would prefer the other bit.
Real data/prefix corruption remains invalid; no mask of XOR1; raw never published as scientific data.
Reject55 path without dedicated ownership, TIMEOUT off evidence, route/pin match or quiescent presence/boot owner before queue/GPIO mutation.
Queue failure; exact completion success; completion timeout/foreign descriptor; DMA remains persistent and no GPIO takeover on unknown completion.
Deadline expires before queue, after completion before handoff, while tail completion is pending; known framing cleanup versus unknown phase quarantine.
Restore output-selector mismatch, unexpected SCLK level and incomplete final edge cause isolation and prevent subsequent register transaction.
Config generation change, RESET/new-data error, pulse fence_missed and held-repeat rules retain same hard failure behavior.
Current matrix/rail/battery and normalRDATA path unchanged; diagnostic exit restores complete snapshot and caches/generation as before.
HIL must verify55SPI+1GPIO clocks with no extra edge, both CRC parities and repeated restored normal reads; without waveform evidence result remains diagnostic timing candidate.
commands_run: Read-only rg/sed of repository, local IDF and existing extracted datasheet text; Python JSON aggregation/independent CRC validation; all successful read/JSON commands exit0 apart from exploratory rg paths explicitly absent. No target compilation or hardware call.

later_authorized_implementation.scope: Diagnostic-only ADSCHK=TAIL,200; same2s/500ms reserve. Main/science/boot speed policy unchanged. Implementation now present; initial scope remains the original read-only decision record.

partial_byte_evidence_addendum.resolution: Retain diagnostic55+1 under SDK contract; complete target prefix/CRC validation remainsHIL, physicalVerified=0. Do not substitute a synthetic mock for hardware evidence.
